---
description: task as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: splitting the work
arguments:
  shared: What every piece is told before its own brief, written once here.
  together: true gives the pieces one notes file, named in each brief, which each of them reads and adds to; where there is no folder they may all write in, the answer says so and each works alone.
  agent: The agent definition every piece is an instance of; left out, your own.
  pieces: The pieces, each an object - brief, what it is to do, in full; agent, another definition for this piece; attach, what it is handed by name, as delegate takes it, the names of your own window among them; for and leave, as delegate takes them; fork, true to start it from your own work as it stands, an instance of your own definition; keep, true to keep it past this turn's reply so agent_message can reach it; name, a short name for it; plays, whom it plays, where you play nobody; returns, what its answer is to hold.
---
Starts every piece at once, each an agent with a window of its own, and answers once all of them have ended: for each piece the name it goes by this turn, how it ended, its answer cut to a receipt, the lines of the file that hold its whole answer, and what it used. A piece reads as you read: if you play a character, it plays that character. A fork holds everything you hold now, and the provider's cache serves it what you were sent. A list to work through goes in batches, a piece for each: each piece starts with its own batch and nothing of the others', and the notes file carries a short running note from one to the next.
